author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The Author Works route shell is duplicated between the mer and titlar pages.
findings.consequence: Future fixes to route validation, async cache identity, stale-response handling, SSR status mapping, SEO fallback, or loading/error markup must be made in two files, increasing the chance that one Author Works variant regresses while the other remains correct.
findings.evidence: app/pages/författare/[author]/mer.vue lines 35-67 and 77-99 match the same data-fetch/cache/status/head structure in app/pages/författare/[author]/titlar/index.vue lines 35-67 and 77-99, differing only in the variant identity and copy passed to the shared AuthorWorksContent component.
findings.recommendation: Extract the shared route-state behavior into a small composable such as useAuthorWorksPage({ variant, pageLabel, loadingLabel }) returning accepted, works, authorId, and description, then keep each route responsible only for variant-specific labels and template copy.
verification: rg -n "AuthorWorksContent|author-works|författare/.*/mer|/mer|variant=\"mer\"|useAuthorQuickSearchContextPublisher|validateAuthorRouteParam|authors/\{author_id\}/works" app test tests server shared -S
